name: @taste-and-see/worker-accounting-metrics
description: Accounting SaaS-metrics worker (TS-260). A scheduled process that, nightly, triggers service-accounting to compute the daily SaaS-metrics snapshot (MRR / ARR / ARPU / movement / net + gross revenue retention) from ledger primitives and persist it to saas_metrics_daily. The worker holds no datastore — it makes one shared-secret-pinned internal call per day to POST /api/v1/internal/accounting/saas-metrics/compute. Uses a setTimeout cadence loop (the platform's established scheduled-worker idiom — see outbox-relay / wellness-summary / identity-janitor), NOT BullMQ: the compute is idempotent + absolute-date keyed so a missed or duplicated tick self-heals. PRD §10.3; PDD §11.2, §23.2.
